description: Attach an email address to the account and send it a verification link. A human must click that link within 30 days or the provisional account and its domains are deleted. Use this right after signup.

api_key.description: Your AgentDomains API key (adom_…). Only needed when this MCP connection has no `Authorization: Bearer` header, for example right after calling signup.

email.description: The email address to attach and send the verification link to.

name: attach_email
title: Attach an email
